system.description:
Range 60ft; one creature or one object up to a 10ft cube; unwilling creatures: Will negates. Creature into creature: any beast or monster of Level up to your level; it takes the new form's whole stat block, keeps its mind and loses spellcasting; 1 hour per level (see Changing Shape). Object into object: nonmagical, equal or lesser size; permanent if same material kind (stone to stone), otherwise 1 hour per level. Creature into object: helpless and non-ageing for 1 hour per level. Object into creature: Level up to half your level, obeys you, 1 hour per level. Dispel Magic ends it.

Classes: Wizard
